comparison.objective: Load a Charpy specimen notch away from the striker, centered and square on anvils; candidate uses a hammer to fracture insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Orient and seat a specimen for a later impact test versus actively align a mandrel, deliver regulated impacts, withdraw safely and recover fragments.
comparison.success_condition: Specimen is correctly oriented, centered and square before striking; detailed tolerances are absent. Candidate requires actual contact-driven fracture of four notches and containment of all fragments.
comparison.reason: This is the closest impact-related record, but it tests pre-impact specimen loading rather than executing and controlling fracture while preserving installed components.
